notes: Region-composition check for /login (the primary illustrated state on the artboard, 'Sign in' tab active). Full page: the real LoginPage (src/app/login/page.tsx) inside AuthFrame — no AppShell/Sidebar, matching the artboard's own full-1440px split-screen frame (left identity panel / right form panel), no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md).

This lane found NO composition defects on this page — it was already built carefully by a prior lane (AuthFrame.tsx/AuthPanel.tsx/LoginPage.tsx headers), including correctly-reasoned, already-logged deviations from the artboard's own placeholder content: the artboard's headline ('What is binding on you, when it bites, and what it costs.') and its fabricated '1,434 items...' copy are explicitly marked placeholder in README ('Fidelity') and are not shipped (CLAUDE.md rule 2, never fabricate numbers) — the real tagline + the real BAND_ORDER urgency-band scale render in that slot instead, both real vocabulary. The artboard's 'Keep me signed in' checkbox is not built because src/lib/supabase-browser.ts's client has no session-only mode wired and that file is outside this lane's write set (logged). This spec exists to LOCK this already-correct composition in place, not to fix anything.

This lane's own mount infrastructure needed one fix to render /signup at all: SignupPage.tsx calls `supabase.auth.getUser()` on mount to redirect an already-signed-in visitor away, which the pre-existing generic stub-supabase-browser.mjs (deliberately 'fake-but-authenticated' for OTHER mounts' click-fires-callback proofs) has no `getUser` method for at all — threw, blanking the whole mount. New stub-supabase-browser-auth.mjs (signed-out steady state: getSession/getUser both resolve null) used by both compose-login and compose-signup instead; the generic stub is untouched, so every mount that already depends on its authenticated shape is unaffected.
